query: SELECT ts,id,jsonb_build_object('id',id,'ts',ts,'type',type,'session_id',session_id,'caller_id',caller_id::text,'tool',tool,'duration_ms',duration_ms,'is_error',is_error,'client_name',client_name,'client_version',client_version,'attrs',attrs) AS event FROM events WHERE project_id=$1 AND ts>=$2 AND (ts,id)<($3,$4) AND ($5::text IS NULL OR type=$5) AND ($6::text IS NULL OR tool=$6) AND ($7::text IS NULL OR tool ILIKE '%'||$7||'%' OR attrs->>'message' ILIKE '%'||$7||'%' OR attrs->>'error_message' ILIKE '%'||$7||'%') AND ($8::bigint IS NULL OR caller_id=$8) AND ($9::boolean IS NULL OR is_error=$9) ORDER BY ts DESC,id DESC LIMIT 101
